_comment: PILOT's voice. engine: kokoro (local, default) | breeze (homelab TTS, voice designed by instruction, slow) | fish (Fish Audio; only with a reference_id you own, e.g. a model made from the operator's own recording). The kokoro voice is an original blend of two stock British male styles, pitched quick and bright; no one's voice is cloned. Rendered lines are cached on disk by text hash (~/.cache/bromigos/pilot-tts), so repeats cost nothing.

breeze.instruction: A young British man, quick and slightly breathless, bright and warm, talking a little fast with nervous, eager enthusiasm. Light London accent. Clear and friendly.
